patches.name: Clean desktop
patches.description: Blocks verified display/video ad loaders, collapses ad spaces, and hides verified banners and upgrade buttons on frontend 3.0.24, including Go ad free banners and their reserved space on player-history and match-detail pages. Supported desktop views bypass cache so cached ad scripts are filtered too. Unknown frontends retain original behavior. Contains executable JavaScript client edits. See validation notes for runtime limits. Automatic Blitz client/frontend updates are off by default; manual checks remain available. Maintains the native archive checksum in the final four bytes of icudtl.dat.

patches.name: Remove telemetry
patches.description: Blocks verified Blitz Science event/error uploads and Google Analytics requests in desktop and overlay sessions. Disables Electron/native crash-handler setup, hardware-spec replies, open-window usage reporting and machine-ID profile segmentation. Retains game IPC, account APIs and feature-flag machine IDs. Local logs and functional game-data requests remain; this is not a guarantee that every native or future telemetry path is removed. Contains executable JavaScript client edits. Automatic Blitz client/frontend updates are off by default; manual checks remain available. Maintains the native archive checksum in the final four bytes of icudtl.dat.
